dz: 奥托一世国王选举他六岁的儿子奥托二世为东法兰克人王国的明显继承人和共治者. 他在Aachen被加冕,并被置于祖母Matilda的监护之下.
de: King Otto I elects his six-year-old son Otto II as heir apparent and co-ruler of the East Frankish Kingdom. He is crowned at Aachen, and placed under the tutelage of his grandmother Matilda.

t: Al-Hakam 二世在父亲Abd al-Rahman 三世去世后成为科尔多瓦的哈里发.
te: Al-Hakam II becomes caliph of Cordoba upon the death of his father Abd al-Rahman III.
dz: Al-Hakam 二世在父亲Abd al-Rahman 三世去世后成为科尔多瓦的哈里发.
de: Al-Hakam II becomes caliph of Cordoba upon the death of his father Abd al-Rahman III.
